text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hussein says parliamentary elections are to be held on time (next November) and, in an indirect comment on the Islamists boycott of elections, the monarch says he is ready to open a dialogue with all Jordanians.

- Prime Minister Abdul-Salam al-Majali meets on Saturday the delegation of parties which have called for a boycott of the parliamentary elections to agree on rules for a dialogue to defuse the growing crisis in confidence.
AD-DUSTOUR - Jordan buys 50,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for mid-October shipment.
- Prime Minister Majali phones Palestinian President Yasser Arafat to brief him on outcome of the Jordanian-Israeli summit in Aqaba between the king and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netenyahu.
